summary: Implemented a production-safe historical QuickBooks migration CLI. Added app/src/QuickBooks/History.js, app/scripts/migrate-quickbooks-history.js, package script quickbooks:migrate-history, and six MySQL integration tests. Full suite passes: 78 tests, 0 failures.
pending_tasks: No code task remains. Operational use requires real Intuit credentials and an authorized/bootstrap-complete realm: run dry-run, review JSON and conflicts, run apply with --set-cutover if required, inspect queued jobs, then enable posting and monitor/reconcile.
decisions: Goal: test Worker/Post/Client against realistic transport. Decision: mock only src/QuickBooks/OAuth.js (OAuthClientNew returns fake makeApiCall; wFreshConnection reads real DB connection row), keeping Client.js requestid/401-retry/query logic real. Why: plan requires mocking the local adapter, not intuit-oauth internals; bun mock.module cannot access the unmocked original module. Invalidates-if: OAuth.js export surface changes. | Goal: reliable job claiming. Decision: use UTC_TIMESTAMP() instead of NOW() in wClaim_SyncJobs. Why: mysql2 pool timezone is 'Z' so JS Dates persist as UTC, but dev MySQL server runs local time (UTC+2), making backoff/lease comparisons wrong by 2h. Invalidates-if: pool timezone config changes. | Goal: deterministic reruns of committed-fixture tests. Decision: posting tests purge by deterministic SourceKeys and Note marker 'qbtest-post' both before setup and after; QuickBooksEvent rows must be deleted before jobs (FK). | Goal: migrate historical QBO data safely. Decision: CLI has explicit --dry-run versus --apply modes and requires both --from-cycle and --to-cycle. Why: historical replay is destructive accounting work and must be bounded/reviewed. | Goal: prevent duplicate QBO accounting. Decision: dry-run and apply query deterministic DocNumbers and reject unlinked QBO matches; existing linked jobs remain idempotent via SourceKey. | Goal: preserve producer payout dependencies. Decision: enqueue all cycle journals/Bills first, daily journals second, producer payouts last; reject unrelated runnable jobs and existing payout-before-Bill ordering hazards. | Goal: prevent partial staging. Decision: --apply requires posting disabled, re-locks/revalidates the connection row, optionally moves cutover earlier only with --set-cutover, and atomically queues all jobs plus audit event in one transaction. | Goal: isolate tests. Decision: inject a read-only document lookup into test options rather than Bun mock.module, because Bun module mocks leaked across test files.
